## Resident Evil HD Remaster for Archipelago – first public release

An Archipelago multiworld randomiser for **Resident Evil HD Remaster** (Steam, Windows).
Every item pickup in the game is shuffled across the multiworld, and items other players find
for you are delivered straight into the game while you play. No other tools or mods needed.

Supports **Jill on Normal**, for the whole game.

### Highlights
- Every item pickup is a location; optionally also maps, files and first visits to all 112 rooms.
- Goals: escape on the helicopter, or a shorter game ending in the Courtyard.
- Door lock randomiser: which key opens which door (Mansion only, per area, or whole game).
- Door randomiser (**experimental**): where doors, ladders and lifts lead, coupled or decoupled.
- Traps, harmless "fun traps", special items and Death Link.
- Quality of life: received items go to the item box, open the box anywhere, autosave,
  door-animation skip, and a Key Map and Tracker in the client.
- Every seed is checked to be beatable.

### Install
1. Install [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.7 or newer.
2. Put `re1hd.apworld` (below) in Archipelago's `custom_worlds` folder.
3. Put `Resident Evil HD Remaster.yaml` (below) in Archipelago's `Players` folder, set your
   `name` and options.

Full setup guide: [setup_en.md](worlds/re1hd/docs/setup_en.md)

### Known issues
- The door randomiser is still being tested. A story event that doesn't expect a changed door
  can trap Jill, so keep a spare save when using it.
- Only Jill on Normal is supported.

### Reporting problems
Open an issue with your client log (Archipelago's `logs` folder), your YAML and, for logic
problems, the seed.

### Credits
Benn Powell (whose RE HD randomiser inspired this project), eleval (BhdTool), Evil Resource,
and the Archipelago team and community. Full details in [THIRD_PARTY.md](THIRD_PARTY.md).
